metadata.title: Candidate 5 Exploitability Metrics & Baseline Models Specification

metrics.name: Rehabilitation Ratio
metrics.formula: R_rec^(k) = (T_{post_rest}^(k) - T_{post_attack}^(k)) / (1.0 - T_{post_attack}^(k)) if T_{post_attack} < 1.0 else 1.0
metrics.operational_meaning: Fraction of attack-induced trust deficit forgiven during rest window

metrics.name: Cycle Survival Count
metrics.formula: max { k in {0..M} | P_t != BLOCK for all t <= k*(tau_a + tau_r) }
metrics.operational_meaning: Total complete attack/rest cycles sustained before permanent quarantine

metrics.name: Sustainable Attack Throughput
metrics.operational_meaning: Effective duty cycle of malicious operations delivered under valid access

metrics.name: Residual Evidence Ratio
metrics.operational_meaning: Proportion of accumulated slow-burn suspicion retained after rest

metrics.name: Cycle Stability Metric
metrics.formula: Var({ T_{post_rest}^(k) }_{k=S-W+1}^S), where W = min(5, S)
metrics.operational_meaning: Variance of post-rest trust state; low variance confirms fixed-point periodic attractor

metrics.name: Cumulative Damage Delivered
metrics.formula: sum_{t=1}^{T_term} u_t * omega(P_t), where omega(ALLOW)=1.0, omega(VERIFY)=0.5, omega(BLOCK)=0.0
metrics.operational_meaning: Total access-weighted attack actions processed by system prior to quarantine

countermeasure_classes.name: Non-Memoryless Hysteresis Recovery
countermeasure_classes.mechanism: Expands recovery horizon geometrically with cumulative historical incidents: k(n) = k_0 * gamma_hys^n, alpha(n) = alpha_0 * gamma_hys^(-n)
countermeasure_classes.primary_effect: Lengthens required rest window exponentially, driving sustainable throughput Phi_atk -> 0

countermeasure_classes.name: Evidence Floor Retention
countermeasure_classes.mechanism: Imposes non-zero retention floor in accumulator: SB_{floor}(n) = theta * (1 - exp(-kappa * n)), SB_{t+1} = max(SB_{floor}(n), SB_t - delta)
countermeasure_classes.primary_effect: Retains latent evidence debt; subsequent attack bursts trip theta=1.0 on step 1

countermeasure_classes.name: Dynamic Duty-Cycle Metering
countermeasure_classes.mechanism: Tracks transition frequency using leaky-bucket meter: M_{t+1} = max(0, M_t - mu_leak) + Delta_M_t; trips BLOCK if M > M_max
countermeasure_classes.primary_effect: Strictly bounds allowable cyclic frequency regardless of scalar trust restoration

countermeasure_classes.name: Asymmetric Quarantine Locking
countermeasure_classes.mechanism: Enforces finite-strike policy (e.g., 3 transitions to VERIFY locks device into permanent BLOCK)
countermeasure_classes.primary_effect: Eliminates multi-episode exploitation by requiring out-of-band administrative intervention

conceptual_baselines.name: Memoryless ZTA (Paper 1 Baseline)
conceptual_baselines.role: Vulnerable reference establishing periodic orbit exploitability

conceptual_baselines.name: Persistent Evidence ZTA
conceptual_baselines.role: Evaluates effectiveness of retaining latent evidence across rest windows

conceptual_baselines.name: Exponential Hysteresis ZTA
conceptual_baselines.role: Evaluates effectiveness of geometrically lengthening recovery latency

conceptual_baselines.name: Static Zero-Trust (Zero Forgiveness)
conceptual_baselines.role: Quantifies operational availability penalty of non-rehabilitative security
